th 13/15 February 2024 1.
Learned counsel for the parties are present.

2. This criminal revision application has been filed for the following reliefs: -
"That the instant revision application is directed for setting aside order dated 13/09/19 passed in Misc. Cr. Application No. 929/2019 by C.J.M., Ranchi, in connection with Daily Market P.S. Case No. 19/2016 corresponding to G.R. Case No.
3301/2016 registered under Sections 498A/323/504/506 of IPC and under Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act whereby and whereunder the Learned C.J.M.,
Ranchi, rejected the discharge petition filed u/s 239 by the petitioner, Now pending in the court of Shri M. F. Kirmani, C.J.M., Ranchi."
3. After some argument, the learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this petition.
